links.outcome: Reading level of chatbot responses versus recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: All models exceeded the recommended sixth-grade reading level; FRES scores remained below the recommended threshold. Gemini 3.5 Pro produced the most complex text; DeepSeek-V4 the most readable.
links.quote: However, all models exceeded the recommended sixth-grade reading level, and FRES scores remained below the recommended threshold.

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of chatbot patient education responses (readability indices)
links.effect: All four chatbots exceeded the sixth-grade reading level and had FRES scores below the recommended threshold; readability varied across models.
links.quote: However, all models exceeded the recommended sixth-grade reading level, and FRES scores remained below the recommended threshold.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM responses to patient education questions regarding robot-assisted radical cystectomy across standardized quality, transparency, and readability metrics, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
